resources.string: Export status, Sync now, permissions and local activity. Google Health reads separately.
Eligible saved rows: %1$s\nProvider-acknowledged local ledger: %2$s\nPending export: %3$s

Counts describe saved blood-label export, not Bluetooth imports or sensor exports. Acknowledged is the locally retained export ledger, not a fresh provider readback; older retained records may be included. Unknown means not checked or not safely determined. Acceptance time records an observed provider write acknowledgement, not the reading time or proof of a new insertion; a safe re-sync may update an existing record.

Pull down from the top or use Sync now to export eligible saved readings to Health Connect when export is enabled. When export is off, pulling only checks status and never enables it. Refresh status only observes the provider, permission and saved-reading export status; it never exports. Busy pulls and button presses are coalesced. These actions do not fetch readings from a Bluetooth meter.

1. Bluetooth meter → Juggluco: the meter must connect and readings must be saved. Readings waiting for your choice are not exported.

2. Juggluco → Health Connect: Sync now exports saved blood-label history. Provider acknowledgement means Health Connect accepted the write, not that another app displayed it.

3. Health Connect → Google Health: allow Google Health to read blood glucose in Health Connect, then check Google Health itself. Juggluco cannot confirm Google Health display or cloud sync and does not access your Google account.

Saved historical rows do not contain their original unit or meter identity. Export uses the configured glucose unit and blood label; it does not guess units or attribute readings to this meter. If old history used mixed units, review it before enabling export. Safety pauses preserve the export ledger; disabling and enabling does not reset it. Checks repeat about every 30 seconds while this app process is alive, and resume when the app starts; Android may suspend the process.
The latest 40 events are saved on this device across restarts. Only action times, state codes and counts are logged — no glucose values, reading timestamps, patient data or meter identifiers.

Safety-paused. Check the configured glucose unit, blood label and complete source history. Retained export state must not be cleared to bypass this pause.
